title: Range of Gaussian bivariate stability
statement: Let $\Phi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function, and let $B_\rho(\alpha,\beta)$ be the standard Gaussian product measure of the set of $(x,y)\in\mathbb R^2$ for which $\Phi(x)\le\alpha$ and $\Phi(\rho x+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,y)\le\beta$. For all $\rho,\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb R$, one has $0\le B_\rho(\alpha,\beta)\le1$.
